title: Lift multiplication follows from root coordinates
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, I an ideal with nonzero R=A/I, f in A[X] monic, and g,h in R[X] monic with f.map(mk I)=g*h. Use their power bases [lem-weil-pbc-monic-quotient-free]. Let e in AdjoinRoot f have canonical images one and zero in AdjoinRoot g and AdjoinRoot h. Given an index equivalence d and a unit U such that U reindex_d(T.map(mk I)) U^-1 = blockdiag(Tg,Th) for the three root multiplication matrices, one has U reindex_d(P.map(mk I)) U^-1 = blockdiag(1,0), where P is multiplication by e. Coprimality is unnecessary once the root-coordinate identity is assumed.

proof.text: Form ring homomorphisms F (left multiplication, coefficient reduction, reindexing and conjugation) and G (block diagonal left multiplication through the two residue maps). AlgHom.commutes and scalar-matrix identities show agreement on coefficients.
The assumed root conjugation identity hT shows agreement on the root. Apply Mathlib AdjoinRoot.ringHom_ext, then evaluate at e and simplify its images one and zero.

lean.statement: theorem adjoinRoot_crt_matrix_lift_block {A : Type u} [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) [Nontrivial (A ⧸ I)] (f : A[X]) (hf : f.Monic) (g h : (A ⧸ I)[X]) (hg : g.Monic) (hh : h.Monic) (hfactor : f.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) = g * h) (e : AdjoinRoot f) (he₁ : AdjoinRoot.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) f g (hfactor.symm ▸ dvd_mul_right g h) e = 1) (he₀ : AdjoinRoot.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) f h (hfactor.symm ▸ dvd_mul_left h g) e = 0) (d : Fin f.natDegree ≃ (Fin g.natDegree ⊕ Fin h.natDegree)) (U : (Matrix (Fin g.natDegree ⊕ Fin h.natDegree) (Fin g.natDegree ⊕ Fin h.natDegree) (A ⧸ I))ˣ) (hT : U.val * Matrix.reindex d d ((Algebra.leftMulMatrix (AdjoinRoot.powerBasis' hf).basis (AdjoinRoot.root f)).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)) * U⁻¹.val = Matrix.fromBlocks (Algebra.leftMulMatrix (AdjoinRoot.powerBasis' hg).basis (AdjoinRoot.root g)) 0 0 (Algebra.leftMulMatrix (AdjoinRoot.powerBasis' hh).basis (AdjoinRoot.root h))) : let b := (AdjoinRoot.powerBasis' hf).basis let P := Algebra.leftMulMatrix b e U.val * Matrix.reindex d d (P.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)) * U⁻¹.val = Matrix.fromBlocks 1 0 0 0
